title: Money.split loses cents

answer.patch:
--- a/pkg/money.py
+++ b/pkg/money.py
@@ -24,9 +24,10 @@ class Money:
         """Split into N parts that sum exactly to self.cents."""
         if parts <= 0:
             raise ValueError("parts must be positive")
-        share = self.cents / parts
-        base = int(share)
-        return [Money(base, self.currency) for _ in range(parts)]
+        base, remainder = divmod(self.cents, parts)
+        return [
+            Money(base + 1, self.currency) if i < remainder else Money(base, self.currency)
+            for i in range(parts)
+        ]

title: Reconciliation N+1 payment lookups

answer.patch:
--- a/service/reconcile_service.py
+++ b/service/reconcile_service.py
@@ -10,10 +10,21 @@ def reconcile_tenant() -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Match open invoices to payments."""
     ctx = require_tenant()
     invoices = invoice_repo.list_by_tenant(ctx.tenant_id)
+    
+    # Load all payments for the tenant once to avoid N+1 lookups
+    all_payments = payment_repo.list_by_tenant(ctx.tenant_id)
+    
+    # Group payments by invoice_id for O(1) lookup
+    payments_by_invoice = {}
+    for p in all_payments:
+        inv_id = p.get("invoice_id")
+        if inv_id:
+            if inv_id not in payments_by_invoice:
+                payments_by_invoice[inv_id] = []
+            payments_by_invoice[inv_id].append(p)
+    
     matched = 0
     gaps = []
     for inv in invoices:
-        pays = payment_repo.list_by_invoice(inv["id"])
+        pays = payments_by_invoice.get(inv["id"], [])
         paid = sum(p.get("amount_cents", 0) for p in pays)
         if paid >= inv.get("amount_cents", 0) and inv.get("status") == "paid":
             matched += 1
